topic: Places and Buildings El: Sightseeing & Places of Worship

items.definition: A large green space with trees and grass.
A building with pictures and art to see.
items.example: We go to the art gallery.

items.definition: A very big old stone building with walls.
A building where you see old things and learn.
items.example: I see dinosaurs in the museum.

items.definition: A building where you watch actors and shows.
items.example: We watch a play at the theatre.

items.definition: A place where wild animals live and you visit.
items.example: I see lions at the zoo.

items.definition: A building where Christians pray and worship.
items.example: We go to church on Sunday.

items.definition: A very large and important church building.
A building where Muslims pray and worship.
items.example: My friend goes to the mosque.

items.definition: A building where Jewish people pray and worship.
A building where people (mostly Buddhists) pray to gods or spirits.
